result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations: evaluation of a double exponential integral via Gamma (Pi) functions and a Beta integral, the Fourier-integral solution of the heat equation with a Green's-function (adjoint) argument, and equations of motion for the axes of a fluid ellipsoid involving integrals over Delta.
result.transcription:
$\int_0^\infty e^{-\eta\eta}\int_0^\infty e^{-2\eta x - xx} x^{s-1}\,\partial x\,\partial\eta\,\varepsilon^s = \int_0^\infty e^{-\eta\eta}\,\eta\,\partial\eta\int_0^\infty e^{-2\eta\eta t-\eta\eta tt}\,t^{s-1}\,\partial t = \frac12\varepsilon^s\,\Pi\frac{s-1}{2}\int_0^\infty (1+t)^{-\frac{s+1}{2}}\,t^{s-1}\,\partial t$
$1+t=\frac1y$
$t=\frac1y-1$
$\partial t=-\frac{\partial y}{yy}$
$\int_0^1 (1-y)^{s-1}\,y^{\frac{-1-s}{2}}\,\partial y=\frac{\Pi(s-1)\,\Pi\frac{-1-s}{2}}{\Pi\frac{s-1}{2}}$
$\int_0^\infty e^{-2\eta x-xx}x^{s-1}\partial x\;\frac12\sum\frac{(-2\eta)^n}{n!}\Pi\left(\frac{n+s}{2}-1\right)=$ [-$\frac12(\Pi\frac{s}{2}\ldots\Pi\frac{s}{2})$-]
$=\frac12\left(\Pi(\frac s2-1)u-\Pi(\frac{s-1}{2})u'\right)e^{\frac12\eta\eta}$
[-$=\frac12\varepsilon^s 2^{s-1}\Pi(\frac s2-1)\Pi\frac{s}{2}\Pi\frac{-1-s}{2}\frac{1}{\sqrt\pi}$-]
$+\frac12\int_0^\infty e^{xxi}x^{s-2}\partial x=$ [-...-] $\frac12\varepsilon^{s-1}\Pi\frac{s-3}{2}$
$=\frac12\varepsilon^s\,\Pi(s-1)\,\Pi\frac{-1-s}{2}$
$\Pi(s-1)=2^{s-1}\Pi(\frac s2-1)\,\Pi(\frac{s-1}{2})\,\frac{1}{\sqrt\pi}$
$=\frac12\varepsilon^s\,\Pi\frac{s-1}{2}\int_0^\infty (1+t)^{-\frac{s+1}{2}}\,t^{s-1}\,\partial t$
$\int_0^1(1-y)^{s-1}$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}=aa\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}\quad t=0\quad u=f(x)$
$e^{\alpha x+aa\alpha\alpha t}$
$e^{(\alpha-\lambda)\sqrt{-1}x-aa\alpha\alpha t}\quad e^{-(\alpha-\lambda)\sqrt{-1}x-aa\alpha\alpha t}$
$u=F(x,t,\alpha)\quad u=c_1F(x,t,\alpha_1)+c_2F(x,t,\alpha_2)+\ldots$
$u=\int_a^b F(x,t,\alpha)\,\psi(\alpha)\,\partial\alpha$
$u=\frac1\pi\int_0^\infty\partial\alpha\int_{-\infty}^\infty\cos(x-\lambda)\,e^{-aa\alpha\alpha t}f(\lambda)\,\partial\lambda$
$f(x)=\frac1\pi\int_0^\infty\partial\alpha\int_{-\infty}^\infty\cos\alpha(x-\lambda)\,f(\lambda)\,\partial\lambda$
$u=\frac1\pi\int_0^\infty\partial\alpha\int_{-\infty}^\infty\cos\alpha(x-\lambda)\,e^{-aa\alpha\alpha t}f(\lambda)\,\partial\lambda$
$a\frac{\partial^2a}{\partial t^2}=2\sigma-2\varepsilon\pi\int_0^\infty\frac{a^2\,\partial s}{\Delta\,(a^2+s)}$
$\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial t}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial b}{\partial t}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial c}{\partial t}\right)^2=\mathrm{Const}+4\varepsilon\pi\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}$
$b\sqrt\varepsilon\quad\frac{1}{abc}\quad(1+\frac{s\varepsilon}{c})\quad 1+abc\,c\quad 1+\frac{sc}{c^3}$
$(\zeta^2+\frac{1}{\zeta^2})\left(\frac{\partial\zeta}{\partial t}\right)^2=\mathrm{Const}+4\varepsilon\pi\frac1c\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\sqrt{(1+\frac{s}{\zeta^2})(1+\zeta^2 s)}\;1+\frac{s}{c^3}}$
$(\zeta^2+\frac{1}{\zeta^2})\frac{\partial^2\zeta}{\partial t^2}+(\zeta-\frac{1}{\zeta^3})\left(\frac{\partial\zeta}{\partial t}\right)^2=-2\varepsilon\pi\frac1c\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\left(\frac{\ldots}{1+\frac{s}{\zeta^2}}-\frac{1}{1+\zeta^2 s}\right)$
$\frac{N(\zeta^2-\frac{1}{\zeta^2})s}{1+(\zeta^2+\frac{1}{\zeta^2})s+s^2}$
$v\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}-aa\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}\right)\partial x\,\partial t=0$
$\int v\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}-aa\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}\right)\partial x\,\partial t=0$
$\int v\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}\partial t=uv-\int u\frac{\partial v}{\partial t}\partial t$
$-\int aa\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}v\,\partial x=-aa\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}v+aa\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}u-aa\int u\frac{\partial^2v}{\partial x^2}\partial t$
$\int uv\,\partial x$
$v=\frac{1}{2a}\frac{1}{\sqrt{\pi(\tau-t)}}e^{-\frac{(x-\xi)^2}{4a^2(\tau-t)}}$

Green's identity / integration by parts with adjoint heat equation and heat kernel
Equation of motion of ellipsoid axis and energy integral
